info.sub_name: 大學精進英文(一)中高級

description.sub_name: 大學精進英文(一)中高級
description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, discuss topics from their course materials, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others.

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6.  Students who need to take a make-up exam must submit an application within 3 days after the scheduled exam, in accordance with the university’s regulations. Students who are absent on the exam day and fail to apply for a make-up exam will receive a score of zero for that exam. Make-up exam scores will be subject to a 20% deduction according to the center’s policy.若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。補考成績按照中心規定，一律打8折。
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
